This isn't just another international school; it's a "Highly Regarded" institution and an "Academic leader" with a strong UK/IB curriculum, so you can expect a truly professional and rigorous environment. With BSO approval, they're held to high British standards, meaning a commitment to quality teaching and learning, but also that you'll be expected to contribute to that high bar. \n\n

Now, let's get down to the brass tacks of your finances, which I know is always a big consideration. The Expected Surplus of BRL 14,213 per month is truly impressive for a single person. This means after covering all your projected monthly expenses, you’ll have a substantial amount left over. This kind of surplus provides incredible flexibility, whether you’re looking to aggressively pay down student loans, build a substantial savings pot for future plans, or simply enjoy a very comfortable lifestyle with plenty of disposable income for travel and experiences around Brazil and beyond. It’s a real game-changer for financial stability and future planning.
